author: Matt Walsh
description:
Today on the Matt Walsh Show, at a hearing over the murder of Iryna Zarutska in North Carolina, an elected official reveals that he is so clueless about his own job that he would not be able to pass a third grade civics exam. I’d like to say that he’s an extreme case. But the fact is that our government, at every level, is infested with the dumbest humans who’ve ever lived. Also, the House passes a voter ID bill. Democrats are taking it about as well as you’d expect. And an olympic athlete cries on camera because his girlfriend broke up with him.
